subject: Discrepancy in the Section 26 24 00 panel schedule circuit assignment between Electrical

messages.text: Coordination review turned up a mismatch on the Section 26 24 00 panel schedule circuit assignment between Electrical Detail 2/E502 and Electrical Panel Schedule E-601 -- can you confirm which is correct before we release for fabrication? No rush on this -- please respond when convenient. No cost impact is anticipated. No schedule impact is expected. Please respond before the electrical rough-in inspection. We don't have a fixed turnaround in mind for this -- it depends on the BIM detailer's next clash pass, which isn't on a set schedule.

Electrical Detail 2/E502 governs for the Section 26 24 00 panel schedule circuit assignment near MDP-1; Electrical Panel Schedule E-601 will be superseded by an updated drawing. No cost impact is anticipated. No schedule impact is expected.
